claims.quote: Transcriptional profiling suggests alterations in the expression of myelin-associated genes in Scn2a conditional knockout mice, highlighting the cellular consequences engendered by Scn2a deletion in oligodendrocytes.
This disruption instigates changes in axonal properties, presynaptic excitability, and synaptic plasticity at the single cell level.
Furthermore, oligodendrocyte-specific Scn2a deletion compromises the integrity of neural circuitry within auditory pathways, leading to auditory hypersensitivity.
